note: Surrounds the 1,768-acre Medicine Creek Reservoir (Harry Strunk Lake). The reservable electric pads are in the Shady Bay campground on a wooded point on the lake; the basic sites are elsewhere around the lake. 3 boat ramps, 2 fish-cleaning stations, an unguarded swim beach, disc golf and an archery range. Park entry permit required. --Claude
summary: ReserveAmerica park page and site list read: 106 sites (64 at 50 A, 8 at 30 A, 34 basic), 2 shower houses, vault toilets, dump, water, open year round, 40 ft unit limit, 180-day window; all 50 reservable RV sites are in Shady Bay. Hookups, sites, facilities, season and booking written; fees left (grid row 2026-10-12). Pin is ~1.4 km E of the campground: re-pin. Waterfront: lakefront doubtful, lakeview suggested. Note cleaned.
flags: PIN MOVE: stored 40.38269,-100.20561 is at the road junction east of the dam, ~1.4 km from the campground (1.2 km from the nearest site). Suggested 40.38747,-100.22092, the centroid of RA's GIS points for 17 sampled Shady Bay sites (RA's own park point 40.38611,-100.21917 is at the loop's south end, ~240 m SE).

WATER (downgrade suggested, lakefront -> lakeview; borderline): RA tags every reservable site 'Near Water - no' and posts no shoreline distance. NAIP shows Shady Bay on a treed point with a sand beach all round. The west-row pads (sites 22-25) sit ~20-35 m from the beach edge, but behind a fairly continuous band of trees. There is no road or day-use strip between them and the water, so this turns on whether that band is a screen; I went down as unsure. The inner sites (01-11, 50-74) are behind the loop road and the bay's reed marsh.
